Description.Name: Wulfbanes
Description.Details:
Wulf Hardy is Draconis affiliated, sporting a rough past from the Kesai liberation. While suffering from a weak constitution and bad allergies, he is dependable - and overall uplifting to be around. The accent of his homeworld leads him to insist it should be spelled Wulf or not at all. He's picked a moniker from coring WFH and WVR infidels of all makes.

Wulfbanes adopts cats when planetbound - and as a result there may have been an incident with some SRMs due to a chase in the cockpit. He likes naps, going fast, and hearing the cacophony of missiles taking flight. He doesn't like plant life, getting hit, or anything that messes with the gyro. Nobody wants to disturb a lounging cat, and nobody wants a repeat negligent discharge.
